name: Evade Charge (Combat, Ki)
body:
Your anticipation allows you to avoid the clumsy charge of your enemy.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation

Benefit(s): As long as you have at least 1 point in your ki pool, you gain a +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attackers using the charge action. In addition, if an attacker misses you while making a charge attack, as an immediate action you can expend 1 point from your ki pool to take an attack of opportunity against that creature.
